The Times reported that Mr. Trump had been briefed last year about Mr. Huang’s relationship with her, but chose not to do anything about it. 《纽约时报》上周报道，黄仁勋是中国一项情报行动的目标，美国情报机构已对身为中国公民的黄乐实施了至少一年的电子监控。《纽约时报》还报道，特朗普去年曾听取有关黄仁勋与黄乐关系的简报，但决定不采取任何行动。 Ms. Huang speaks English well and has relationships with executives at the highest levels of the A.I. chip industry, including Mr. Huang and the leaders of Gigabyte, one of the top assemblers of Nvidia supercomputers, said people who have met her. She has attended industry conferences and private executive dinners. 见过黄乐的人说，她英语流利，与人工智能芯片行业的最高层保持着联系，包括黄仁勋和技嘉科技(Gigabyte)的领导人，技嘉科技是英伟达超级计算机的主要组装商之一。黄乐曾出席行业会议和高管私人晚宴。 It is unclear when Ms. Huang first met Nvidia’s leader. In 2024, around the time the two of them were photographed together at a bar in Taipei, her company, Megaspeed, began a multibillion-dollar purchase of advanced A.I. microchips. 目前不清楚黄乐第一次见到英伟达领导人是什么时候。2024年，两人在台北一家酒吧合影前后，她的公司 Megaspeed开始采购价值数十亿美元 的先进人工智能微芯片。 To many in the industry, the well-funded push by Megaspeed into A.I. appeared to come out of nowhere. 在许多业内人士看来，Megaspeed手握雄厚资金突然大举进军人工智能领域令人颇感意外。 Ms. Huang was connected to a network of companies and investors clustered around Shanghai and Zhejiang province that had used their ties to local officials in Shanghai to push aggressively from mobile video games into data centers, which provide the computing power behind artificial intelligence. 黄乐与一个集中在上海和浙江省的企业及投资者网络存在联系。这个网络利用与上海地方官员的关系，积极推动业务从手机游戏向数据中心扩张。数据中心提供人工智能运行所需的算力。 Megaspeed has been building data centers in Southeast Asia and then renting their computing power to Alibaba, the giant Chinese internet firm, giving China a backdoor way of getting access to advanced Nvidia chips. Nvidia is restricted by the United States from selling those chips directly to China. Megaspeed一直在东南亚建设数据中心，然后将算力出租给中国互联网巨头阿里巴巴，使中国得以通过一条间接渠道使用英伟达的先进芯片。美国限制英伟达直接向中国销售这些芯片。 Beyond its local connections, the network also has a financial link to the Chinese military establishment, through an investment in a cybersecurity subsidiary of China Electronics Technology Group, one of the country’s largest makers of military technology. 除了地方关系，这个企业网络还通过投资中国电子科技集团旗下的一家网络安全子公司与中国军工体系存在财务联系。中国电子科技集团是中国最大的军事技术制造商之一。 去年在华盛顿举行的一场英伟达大会展览活动上，人们参观计算技术展示。 The Chinese government has set goals to overtake the United States as the world’s leader in A.I. technology by 2030. The focus on A.I. has increased across the parts of the Chinese government that specialize in national security, including the spy agency that recruited Ms. Huang. 中国政府已制定目标，要在2030年前超越美国，成为全球人工智能技术的领导者。中国政府内部负责国家安全的部门日益重视人工智能，其中就包括招募黄乐的情报机构。 China’s M.S.S. spy agency was once a backwater. But when Xi Jinping took over as China’s leader in 2012, he began to invest in the agency. Today it is many times larger than the C.I.A., collecting human intelligence and intercepting electronic communications. The agency also conducts counterintelligence operations. 中国国家安全部曾经是一个不起眼的边缘部门。但习近平2012年成为中国领导人后开始加大对该机构的投入。如今，国安部的规模已是美国中央情报局的数倍，既搜集人力情报，也截获电子通信信息，同时还开展反间谍行动。 Peter Mattis, a former C.I.A. counterintelligence analyst, said China’s spy agency had made technology a focus of its activities, seeing it as “the key fight for dominance in the economic world.” 曾任美国中央情报局反间谍分析师的彼得·马蒂斯表示，中国的情报机构已将技术列为工作重点，认为技术是“争夺全球经济主导地位的关键战场”。 “They’re interested in what’s taking place in technology, in the technical specifications of what’s being built and in shaping decision-making as it relates to those things,” said Mr. Mattis, who is now the president of the Jamestown Foundation, a national security think tank. “Jensen is someone you’d want to influence because he wields a lot of power and is at the crux of a world-shaping technology.” “他们关注科技领域正在发生的变化、正在开发的技术有哪些具体规格，以及如何影响与这些技术相关的决策，”现任国家安全智库詹姆斯敦基金会主席的马蒂斯说。“黄仁勋正是他们希望施加影响的人，因为他拥有巨大的影响力，而且身处一项足以改变世界的技术的关键位置。” John Rizzo, an Nvidia spokesman, said that the company does not share classified information with its customers, and that customers do not ask Nvidia to press the U.S. government to change its policies on chip sales to China. 英伟达发言人约翰·里佐表示，公司不会与客户分享机密信息，客户也不会要求英伟达向美国政府施压，改变对华芯片销售政策。 He added that the Chinese government had “consistently promoted its own domestic alternatives in China, including Huawei, and strictly limited imports of our data center products.” 他还说，中国政府“一直在中国推广包括华为在内的本土替代产品，并严格限制进口我们的数据中心产品”。 Mr. Rizzo has maintained that Mr. Huang’s interactions with Ms. Huang were “not unusual” and consistent with the kinds of meetings he has with any of Nvidia’s many customers. 里佐一直坚称，黄仁勋与黄乐的往来“并无异常”，与他同英伟达众多客户举行的其他会面没有区别。 Liu Chang, a spokesman for the Chinese embassy, said The Times reporting was “unsubstantiated” and “nothing but smears against China.” Ms. Huang has not responded to multiple attempts to reach her for comment in recent days. Mr. Rizzo previously said that Mr. Huang’s interactions with Ms. Huang were “not unusual,” and that he speaks annually with thousands of executives who do business with Nvidia. 中国驻美国大使馆发言人刘畅表示，《纽约时报》的报道“毫无根据”，“纯属对中国的污蔑”。记者近日多次尝试联系黄乐请其置评，但均未得到回应。里佐此前表示，黄仁勋与黄乐的往来“并无异常”，而且黄仁勋每年都会与数千名同英伟达有业务往来的高管交谈。 Spokeswomen for the White House and C.I.A. declined to comment. 白宫和中央情报局的发言人均拒绝置评。 Mr. Huang has been steadfast over the past several years in calling for the U.S. government to permit chip makers to sell A.I. technology to China. He has argued that doing so would create competition for Huawei, China’s tech giant, and slow its development of A.I. technology. 过去几年里，黄仁勋始终坚定主张美国政府应允许芯片制造商向中国销售人工智能技术。他认为，这样做可以为中国科技巨头华为制造竞争，从而减缓其人工智能技术的发展。 今年9月，黄仁勋与特朗普总统在白宫出席一场人工智能主题午宴。 In 2025, he persuaded Mr. Trump to roll back a prohibition on A.I. chip sales to China and allow Nvidia to sell a less powerful chip there. He and the president later struck a deal to sell the company’s second-most-powerful chip to China, with the United States taking a 25 percent cut of sales. Mr. Trump later considered allowing Nvidia to sell China its latest chip, known as Blackwell. But he has backed off that idea. 2025年，他说服特朗普撤销 对华销售人工智能芯片的禁令 ， 允许英伟达向中国出售 一款性能较低的芯片。后来，他又与特朗普 达成协议 ，允许公司向中国销售其性能第二强的芯片，美国政府则从销售额中抽取25%。此后，特朗普还 考虑过允许英伟达 向中国出售其最新的Blackwell芯片，但最终放弃了这一想法。 Speaking at an investor conference in May, Mr. Huang said that China should not have access to Nvidia’s best technology, like its Blackwell chips or its forthcoming Rubin chip. He said the United States should have “the first, the most and the best, but simultaneously all American companies should compete globally.” 今年5月，黄仁勋 在一场投资者会议上表示 ，中国不应获得英伟达最先进的技术，例如Blackwell芯片或即将推出的Rubin芯片。他说，美国应该“最先拿到、拿到最多、拿到最好的技术，但与此同时，所有美国公司都应该参与全球竞争”。 Founded in 1983, China’s M.S.S. spy agency long failed to win the confidence of the country’s leaders. The espionage and cyber-hacking arms of the People’s Liberation Army were for years considered the primary intelligence collection arms of Beijing. 中国国家安全部成立于1983年，一直以来未能赢得国家领导层的信任。多年来，中国人民解放军的间谍和网络黑客部门一直被视为北京主要的情报搜集力量。 The agency took on more of China’s espionage work after Beijing and Washington struck a deal in 2015 to curb cyberoperations, according to researchers and U.S. officials. In the years that followed, the Justice Department accused hackers associated with the M.S.S. of attempting to steal U.S. technology and infiltrate U.S. networks. 据研究人员和美国官员称，2015年北京与华盛顿 达成限制网络行动的协议 后，国家安全部承担了更多中国的间谍活动。此后数年，美国司法部指控 与国家安全部有关联的黑客 试图窃取美国技术，并渗透美国的网络。 By 2023, the agency had emerged as a rival to the C.I.A. , and began using A.I. to select and profile targets. It had expanded its network of spies through aggressive recruitment, and used its bigger budget to help Mr. Xi in his ambitions to challenge U.S. dominance. 到2023年，国家安全部已 发展成为美国中央情报局的竞争对手 ，并开始利用人工智能筛选情报目标、建立目标画像。该机构通过大规模招募扩大了间谍网络，还利用增加的预算，协助习近平实现挑战美国主导地位的雄心。 The M.S.S. also used its ties to various Chinese companies to expand its work, in cyber-hacking, espionage and information operations. It is estimated to have hundreds of thousands of agents, which dwarfs the number of counterintelligence officers in the United States. 国家安全部还利用与多家中国公司的关系来扩展其在网络黑客、间谍活动和 信息行动 方面的工作。据估计，该机构拥有数十万名特工，远远超过美国反间谍人员的数量。 The agency continues to largely operate behind the scenes, but under its current leader, Chen Yixin, it has also taken on a more public role in Chinese life. In 2023, the agency created a WeChat account, mainly for domestic propaganda and for encouraging Chinese citizens to report people suspected of being foreign spies. The channel is also used to attack the United States for a supposed Cold War mind-set . 国家安全部在很大程度上仍继续在幕后运作，但在现任部长陈一新的领导下，它在中国社会生活中也扮演了更加公开的角色。2023年，该机构开设了一个微信公众号，主要用于国内宣传，并鼓励中国公民举报疑似外国间谍的人员。该公众号还被用来攻击美国，称其抱有所谓的 冷战思维 。 Mr. Chen is very familiar with the region of eastern China where Ms. Huang operates. A Zhejiang native, he spent a major part of his long career working for the province’s Chinese Communist Party. He served under Mr. Xi when Mr. Xi ran Zhejiang in the early 2000s. Political analysts say their ties are close. 陈一新非常熟悉黄乐从事商业活动的华东地区。他是浙江人，在漫长的职业生涯中，大部分时间都在为该省的中共党组织工作。习近平在2000年代初主政浙江期间，陈一新曾在其手下任职。政治分析人士称两人关系密切。 Mr. Chen has been outspoken about the risks A.I. poses to the Chinese Communist Party. In a September essay in the state-run magazine China Cyberspace, he said that China needed to assert control over A.I. to protect political stability at home, defend against increasingly sophisticated cyberattacks and compete militarily with the United States. He said algorithms would help countries “gain the initiative on the battlefield.” 陈一新一直直言不讳地谈论 人工智能对中国共产党构成的风险 。在9月发表于官方杂志《中国网信》的一篇文章中，他说中国需要加强对人工智能的控制，以维护国内政治稳定、防范日益复杂的网络攻击，并在军事领域与美国竞争。他表示，算法将帮助各国“赢得战场主动权”。 Julian E. Barnes 为《纽约时报》报道美国情报机构和国际安全事务。他撰写安全相关议题已有20余年。 Tripp Mickle 报道英伟达、谷歌和苹果等全球最大的科技公司。他也报道整个科技行业的趋势，包括裁员、生成式AI和机器人出租车等。 Maggie Haberman 是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。 孟建国( Paul Mozur )是时报全球科技记者，常驻台北。此前，他自香港、上海和首尔报道亚洲科技与政治的交叉议题。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 鲁比奥曾对黄仁勋与中国间谍的关系提出警告
description: MAGGIE HABERMAN, JONATHAN SWAN, JULIAN E. BARNES, TRIPP MICKLE2026年11月9日今年春天，一份备忘录在特朗普政府高层官员中传阅，警告称英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋与一名中国间谍关系密切。 Lisi Niesner/Reuters Secretary of State Marco Rubio oversaw the drafting of the highly classified memo this past spring warning top Trump administration officials that Nvidia’s chief executive, Jensen Huang, was in a close relationship with a Chinese spy, multiple people briefed on the matter said. 多位听取了相关简报的人士表示，今年春天，国务卿马尔科·鲁比奥监督起草了一份高度机密的备忘录，向特朗普政府高层发出警告，指出英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋与一名中国间谍关系密切。 The document was based on classified intelligence from electronic surveillance of Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen who was a senior executive at a Singapore-based company that was buying Nvidia’s advanced artificial intelligence chips and being investigated for illegally smuggling them into China. U.S. officials had concluded that Ms. Huang was in a close relationship with the Nvidia chief, who is no relation, and that she had been recruited to spy by China’s top intelligence agency, the Ministry of State Security. 该文件基于对中国公民黄乐（音，英文名Alice Huang)进行电子监控所获取的机密情报。她是一家新加坡公司高管，该公司当时正采购英伟达的先进人工智能芯片，并因涉嫌将这些芯片非法走私至中国而接受调查。美国官员已得出结论，黄女士与这位英伟达掌门人（两人无亲属关系）关系密切，且她已被中国最高情报机构国家安全部招募为间谍。 Mr. Rubio’s involvement in warning administration officials about the situation has not been previously reported. It highlights how concerns about the relationship and the spying were known to senior officials even as Mr. Huang, a pivotal figure in the explosive growth of A.I., remained an influential voice with Mr. Trump over policy on the issue. 鲁比奥参与向政府官员通报情况一事此前未被报道。这凸显出高级官员已经知晓这段关系及对间谍活动的担忧，尽管黄仁勋作为AI爆炸性增长的一个关键人物，在相关政策上至今仍能对特朗普施加重要影响力。 Mr. Huang has opposed calls for more tightly regulating the export of the most advanced A.I. chips and has pushed to be able to sell all but the most recently developed technology to China, the main competitor to the United States in the global rush for A.I. supremacy. 黄仁勋一直反对对最先进人工智能芯片出口实施更严格监管，并积极推动将除最新研发技术以外的所有技术出售给中国。在全球争夺人工智能主导权的角逐中，中国是美国的主要竞争对手。 On Sunday, Nvidia said it was opening an investigation into Mr. Huang after he acknowledged that he had been intimate with Ms. Huang, though the company said it had “no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised.” 周日，英伟达表示，在黄仁勋承认曾与黄女士有亲密关系后，公司正对他展开调查，不过该公司也表示“没有理由相信国家安全或英伟达的机密遭到了泄露”。 In a message to the company, Mr. Huang apologized. 在致公司的一则消息中，黄仁勋表达了歉意。 “I was unfaithful to my wife,” he said. “My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.” “我对妻子不忠，”他说，“我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深表歉意。” A State Department spokesman and a White House spokeswoman declined to comment. 美国国务院发言人及白宫女发言人均拒绝置评。 Mr. Rubio’s memo was circulated to administration officials with high-level security clearances ahead of a trip Mr. Trump took to China in May, the people briefed on the matter said. They spoke on the condition of anonymity to discuss sensitive material. 听取了简报的人士称，在特朗普5月访华前，鲁比奥的备忘录被分发给了拥有高级别安全权限的政府官员。因讨论敏感材料，这些人士要求匿名。 Despite his status as an A.I. pioneer and head of one of the world’s most valuable companies, Mr. Huang was initially left off the list of major business and tech executives invited to join Mr. Trump in China. It is unclear whether the exclusion was connected to the memo. By that point, a number of people inside the administration were concerned about Mr. Huang’s influence on the president’s policy of only lightly regulating A.I., people briefed on the matter said. 尽管是人工智能领域的先驱，也是全球最具价值公司之一的掌门人，但黄仁勋最初并未被列入受邀陪同特朗普访华的主要商业和科技高管名单中。目前尚不清楚这一决定是否与该备忘录有关。听取了简报的人士表示，那时政府内部已有一些人对黄仁勋影响政策的能力感到担忧——总统对人工智能仅实施了轻度的监管。 After Mr. Trump saw media coverage about Mr. Huang being absent from the delegation, the president asked him to join the trip by meeting Air Force One during a layover in Alaska. The president drafted a social media post saying that it was an honor to have “the Great Jensen Huang,” and other business leaders “journeying to the Great Country of China where I will be asking President Xi, a Leader of extraordinary distinction, to ‘open up’ China so that these brilliant people can work their magic.” 看到媒体关于黄仁勋缺席代表团的报道后，特朗普总统要求他在阿拉斯加中转期间与“空军一号”会合，以此加入此次行程。总统起草了一篇社交媒体帖子，称很荣幸能有“伟大的黄仁勋”和其他商业领袖“前往伟大的中国，在那里我将请求杰出非凡的领导人习近平主席‘开放’中国，以便这些才华横溢的人能够施展他们的魔力。” The New York Times reported last month that Mr. Trump was briefed roughly a year ago that the U.S. intelligence community had electronic surveillance of Ms. Huang, and believed that she was an operative working for China’s intelligence services. The surveillance revealed a close relationship between Ms. Huang and a U.S. citizen. When officials asked for the name of the U.S. citizen to be “unmasked” — given Americans’ identities are routinely protected from foreign surveillance — it was revealed to be the Nvidia chief executive. 《纽约时报》上个月报道称，特朗普在大约一年前曾听取简报，得知美国情报界对黄女士进行了电子监控，并认为她是效力于中国情报机构的特工。监控显示黄女士与一名美国公民关系密切。当官员们要求“揭示”该美国公民的姓名时（美国人的身份通常受到保护以免受涉外情报监控），结果显示此人正是英伟达首席执行官。 The president chose at that point not to take any action. He has viewed Nvidia’s chips as integral to America’s competition with China in A.I. He sees Nvidia’s success as crucial to maintaining a robust stock market. 总统当时选择不采取任何行动。他一直将英伟达的芯片视为美国在人工智能领域对华竞争中不可或缺的一部分，并认为英伟达的成功是维持股市强劲势头的关键。 Ms. Huang speaks English well and has relationships with executives at the highest levels of the A.I. chip industry, including with Mr. Huang and the leaders of Gigabyte, one of the top assemblers of Nvidia supercomputers, people who have met her said. 曾与黄乐会面的人士透露，她英语流利，并与人工智能芯片行业的最高层高管保持着关系，其中包括黄仁勋以及英伟达超级计算机顶级组装商之一技嘉的领导人。 It is unclear when Ms. Huang first met Nvidia’s leader. In 2024, around the time the two of them were photographed together with other industry executives at a bar in Taipei, her company, Megaspeed, began a multibillion-dollar purchase of advanced A.I. microchips. 目前尚不清楚黄乐是何时结识这位英伟达领导人的。2024年，大约在他们两人与其他行业高管在台北一家酒吧被拍到合影的同时，她的公司Megaspeed开始了价值数十亿美元的先进人工智能微芯片采购计划。 Nvidia officials have said that Mr. Huang’s interactions with Ms. Huang were “not unusual or unexpected” and consistent with the kinds of meetings he has with any of Nvidia’s many customers. The company has also said customers like Megaspeed do not receive classified business information. 英伟达高管表示，黄仁勋与黄女士的互动“并不反常或出人意料”，且与他同英伟达众多客户中任何一位会面的情况一致。该公司还表示，像Megaspeed这样的客户不会接触到机密商业信息。 In recent years, Megaspeed, despite having essentially a storefront office and little local footprint, purchased $2 billion worth of Nvidia’s products. Megaspeed builds data centers in Southeast Asia that rent out their computing power to Alibaba, the giant Chinese internet company. U.S. officials suspect Megaspeed has been helping smuggle restricted advanced Nvidia chips into China. 近年来，Megaspeed尽管实质上只有一个门面办公室，在当地几乎没有业务足迹，却采购了价值20亿美元的英伟达产品。Megaspeed在东南亚建设数据中心，将其算力出租给中国互联网巨头阿里巴巴。美国官员怀疑，Megaspeed一直在协助将受限的先进英伟达芯片走私至中国。 Ms. Huang has not responded to attempts to reach her. 本报多次尝试联系黄乐未获回应。 Maggie Haberman是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。 Jonathan Swan是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。 Julian E. Barnes为《纽约时报》报道美国情报机构和国际安全事务。他撰写安全相关议题已有20余年。 Tripp Mickle报道英伟达、谷歌和苹果等全球最大的科技公司。他也报道整个科技行业的趋势，包括裁员、生成式AI和机器人出租车等。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。
content: MAGGIE HABERMAN, JONATHAN SWAN, JULIAN E. BARNES, TRIPP MICKLE 2026年11月9日 今年春天，一份备忘录在特朗普政府高层官员中传阅，警告称英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋与一名中国间谍关系密切。 Lisi Niesner/Reuters Secretary of State Marco Rubio oversaw the drafting of the highly classified memo this past spring warning top Trump administration officials that Nvidia’s chief executive, Jensen Huang, was in a close relationship with a Chinese spy, multiple people briefed on the matter said. 多位听取了相关简报的人士表示，今年春天，国务卿马尔科·鲁比奥监督起草了 一份高度机密的备忘录 ，向特朗普政府高层发出警告，指出英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋与一名中国间谍关系密切。 The document was based on classified intelligence from electronic surveillance of Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen who was a senior executive at a Singapore-based company that was buying Nvidia’s advanced artificial intelligence chips and being investigated for illegally smuggling them into China. U.S. officials had concluded that Ms. Huang was in a close relationship with the Nvidia chief, who is no relation, and that she had been recruited to spy by China’s top intelligence agency, the Ministry of State Security. 该文件基于对中国公民黄乐（音，英文名Alice Huang)进行电子监控所获取的机密情报。她是一家新加坡公司高管，该公司当时正采购英伟达的先进人工智能芯片，并因涉嫌将这些芯片非法走私至中国而接受调查。美国官员已得出结论，黄女士与这位英伟达掌门人（两人无亲属关系）关系密切，且她已被中国最高情报机构国家安全部招募为间谍。 Mr. Rubio’s involvement in warning administration officials about the situation has not been previously reported. It highlights how concerns about the relationship and the spying were known to senior officials even as Mr. Huang, a pivotal figure in the explosive growth of A.I., remained an influential voice with Mr. Trump over policy on the issue. 鲁比奥参与向政府官员通报情况一事此前未被报道。这凸显出高级官员已经知晓这段关系及对间谍活动的担忧，尽管黄仁勋作为AI爆炸性增长的一个关键人物，在相关政策上至今仍能对特朗普施加重要影响力。 Mr. Huang has opposed calls for more tightly regulating the export of the most advanced A.I. chips and has pushed to be able to sell all but the most recently developed technology to China, the main competitor to the United States in the global rush for A.I. supremacy. 黄仁勋一直反对对最先进人工智能芯片出口实施更严格监管，并积极推动将除最新研发技术以外的所有技术出售给中国。在全球争夺人工智能主导权的角逐中，中国是美国的主要竞争对手。 On Sunday, Nvidia said it was opening an investigation into Mr. Huang after he acknowledged that he had been intimate with Ms. Huang, though the company said it had “no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised.” 周日，英伟达表示，在黄仁勋承认曾与黄女士有亲密关系后，公司正对他 展开调查 ，不过该公司也表示“没有理由相信国家安全或英伟达的机密遭到了泄露”。 In a message to the company, Mr. Huang apologized. 在致公司的一则消息中，黄仁勋表达了歉意。 “I was unfaithful to my wife,” he said. “My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.” “我对妻子不忠，”他说，“我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深表歉意。” A State Department spokesman and a White House spokeswoman declined to comment. 美国国务院发言人及白宫女发言人均拒绝置评。 Mr. Rubio’s memo was circulated to administration officials with high-level security clearances ahead of a trip Mr. Trump took to China in May, the people briefed on the matter said. They spoke on the condition of anonymity to discuss sensitive material. 听取了简报的人士称，在特朗普5月访华前，鲁比奥的备忘录被分发给了拥有高级别安全权限的政府官员。因讨论敏感材料，这些人士要求匿名。 Despite his status as an A.I. pioneer and head of one of the world’s most valuable companies, Mr. Huang was initially left off the list of major business and tech executives invited to join Mr. Trump in China. It is unclear whether the exclusion was connected to the memo. By that point, a number of people inside the administration were concerned about Mr. Huang’s influence on the president’s policy of only lightly regulating A.I. , people briefed on the matter said. 尽管是人工智能领域的先驱，也是全球最具价值公司之一的掌门人，但黄仁勋最初并未被列入受邀陪同特朗普访华的主要商业和科技高管名单中。目前尚不清楚这一决定是否与该备忘录有关。听取了简报的人士表示，那时政府内部已有一些人对黄仁勋影响政策的能力感到担忧—— 总统对人工智能仅实施了轻度的监管 。 After Mr. Trump saw media coverage about Mr. Huang being absent from the delegation, the president asked him to join the trip by meeting Air Force One during a layover in Alaska. The president drafted a social media post saying that it was an honor to have “the Great Jensen Huang,” and other business leaders “journeying to the Great Country of China where I will be asking President Xi, a Leader of extraordinary distinction, to ‘open up’ China so that these brilliant people can work their magic.” 看到媒体关于黄仁勋缺席代表团的报道后，特朗普总统要求他在阿拉斯加中转期间与“空军一号”会合， 以此加入此次行程 。总统起草了一篇社交媒体帖子，称很荣幸能有“伟大的黄仁勋”和其他商业领袖“前往伟大的中国，在那里我将请求杰出非凡的领导人习近平主席‘开放’中国，以便这些才华横溢的人能够施展他们的魔力。” The New York Times reported last month that Mr. Trump was briefed roughly a year ago that the U.S. intelligence community had electronic surveillance of Ms. Huang, and believed that she was an operative working for China’s intelligence services. The surveillance revealed a close relationship between Ms. Huang and a U.S. citizen. When officials asked for the name of the U.S. citizen to be “unmasked” — given Americans’ identities are routinely protected from foreign surveillance — it was revealed to be the Nvidia chief executive. 《纽约时报》 上个月报道 称，特朗普在大约一年前曾听取简报，得知美国情报界对黄女士进行了电子监控，并认为她是效力于中国情报机构的特工。监控显示黄女士与一名美国公民关系密切。当官员们要求“揭示”该美国公民的姓名时（美国人的身份通常受到保护以免受涉外情报监控），结果显示此人正是英伟达首席执行官。 The president chose at that point not to take any action. He has viewed Nvidia’s chips as integral to America’s competition with China in A.I. He sees Nvidia’s success as crucial to maintaining a robust stock market. 总统当时选择不采取任何行动。他一直将英伟达的芯片视为美国在人工智能领域对华竞争中不可或缺的一部分，并认为英伟达的成功是维持股市强劲势头的关键。 Ms. Huang speaks English well and has relationships with executives at the highest levels of the A.I. chip industry, including with Mr. Huang and the leaders of Gigabyte, one of the top assemblers of Nvidia supercomputers, people who have met her said. 曾与黄乐会面的人士透露，她英语流利，并与人工智能芯片行业的最高层高管保持着关系，其中包括黄仁勋以及英伟达超级计算机顶级组装商之一技嘉的领导人。 It is unclear when Ms. Huang first met Nvidia’s leader. In 2024, around the time the two of them were photographed together with other industry executives at a bar in Taipei, her company, Megaspeed, began a multibillion-dollar purchase of advanced A.I. microchips. 目前尚不清楚黄乐是何时结识这位英伟达领导人的。2024年，大约在他们两人与其他行业高管在台北一家酒吧被拍到合影的同时，她的公司 Megaspeed开始了价值数十亿美元的 先进人工智能微芯片采购计划。 Nvidia officials have said that Mr. Huang’s interactions with Ms. Huang were “not unusual or unexpected” and consistent with the kinds of meetings he has with any of Nvidia’s many customers. The company has also said customers like Megaspeed do not receive classified business information. 英伟达高管表示，黄仁勋与黄女士的互动“并不反常或出人意料”，且与他同英伟达众多客户中任何一位会面的情况一致。该公司还表示，像Megaspeed这样的客户不会接触到机密商业信息。 In recent years, Megaspeed, despite having essentially a storefront office and little local footprint, purchased $2 billion worth of Nvidia’s products. Megaspeed builds data centers in Southeast Asia that rent out their computing power to Alibaba, the giant Chinese internet company. U.S. officials suspect Megaspeed has been helping smuggle restricted advanced Nvidia chips into China. 近年来，Megaspeed尽管实质上只有一个门面办公室，在当地几乎没有业务足迹，却采购了价值20亿美元的英伟达产品。Megaspeed在东南亚建设数据中心，将其算力出租给中国互联网巨头阿里巴巴。美国官员怀疑，Megaspeed一直在协助将受限的先进英伟达芯片走私至中国。 Ms. Huang has not responded to attempts to reach her. 本报多次尝试联系黄乐未获回应。 Maggie Haberman 是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。 Jonathan Swan 是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。 Julian E. Barnes 为《纽约时报》报道美国情报机构和国际安全事务。他撰写安全相关议题已有20余年。 Tripp Mickle 报道英伟达、谷歌和苹果等全球最大的科技公司。他也报道整个科技行业的趋势，包括裁员、生成式AI和机器人出租车等。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 黄仁勋与中国间谍发生婚外情，英伟达展开调查
description: TRIPP MICKLE, MAGGIE HABERMAN, JONATHAN SWAN, JULIAN E. BARNES, ANA SWANSON2026年11月9日英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋是人工智能革命中最有影响力的人物之一，也是特朗普总统颇具影响力的盟友。 Demetrius Freeman for The New York Times Nvidia said on Sunday that it was opening an investigation into Jensen Huang, its chief executive and co-founder, after he acknowledged to the company’s board that he had been intimate with a business executive who U.S. intelligence determined was a Chinese spy. 英伟达周日表示，已对公司首席执行官兼联合创始人黄仁勋展开调查。此前，黄仁勋向公司董事会承认，他曾与一名企业高管发生亲密关系，而美国情报部门认定，该女子是中国间谍。 Mr. Huang’s relationship with the woman, who goes by Alice Huang, became a U.S. government concern after surveillance revealed that she was feeding information directly to Beijing. The revelation raised troubling possibilities because Mr. Huang is one of the most powerful figures in the A.I. revolution as well as an influential ally of President Trump. 这名女子名叫黄乐(音，其英文名为Alice Huang)。美国政府的监控发现，她一直直接向北京提供情报，此后，黄仁勋与她的关系引起了美国政府的关注。这一发现引发了令人不安的种种可能性，因为黄仁勋不仅是人工智能革命中最有影响力的人物之一，也是特朗普总统的重要盟友。 In a message to the company, Mr. Huang apologized. “I was unfaithful to my wife,” he said. “My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.” 黄仁勋在给公司的情况说明中道歉说：“我对妻子不忠。我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。” Nvidia’s board said that it had “no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised,” but that “the board’s inquiry will examine all available information.” It said Mr. Huang “fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it.” The board did not provide more details about the investigation or how long it would take. 英伟达董事会表示，“没有理由认为国家安全或英伟达的商业机密受到了损害”，但“董事会的调查将审查所有可获得的信息”。董事会表示，黄仁勋“完全支持此次审查，并承诺予以配合”。董事会没有透露调查的更多细节，也没有说明调查将持续多长时间。 Mr. Huang, 63, will continue to lead the company during the investigation, the board said. As a co-founder, he has set up a unique structure at Nvidia where he dictates all aspects of its business while overseeing some 60 people who directly report to him. 董事会表示，63岁的黄仁勋将在调查期间继续领导公司。作为联合创始人，他在英伟达建立了一套独特的管理架构，掌控公司业务的方方面面，并直接管理约60名向他汇报的员工。 “Today’s news will not slow Nvidia,” said John Rizzo, a company spokesman. “Jensen is committed to continuing to lead Nvidia as C.E.O. without interruption.” “今天的新闻不会拖慢英伟达的步伐，”公司发言人约翰·里佐说。“黄仁勋将继续不受干扰地履行首席执行官职责，领导英伟达。” The New York Times reported last month that American intelligence agencies had discovered that Mr. Huang had developed a close relationship with a Chinese citizen and chip buyer, who U.S. officials concluded was gathering intelligence for Beijing. 《纽约时报》上个月报道，美国情报机构发现，黄仁勋与一名中国公民建立了密切关系。此人从事芯片采购业务，美国官员认定她正在为北京搜集情报。 The chip buyer was Ms. Huang or Huang Le, whose biography said she worked in China as a TV reporter before becoming a top executive at a Singapore-based data center company that had become one of Nvidia’s biggest customers in Southeast Asia. It bought more than $4.8 billion in chips since June 2024. 这名芯片采购商就是黄乐。据她的个人履历介绍，她曾在中国担任电视记者，之后成为一家总部位于新加坡的数据中心公司的高管。这家公司后来成为英伟达在东南亚最大的客户之一，自2024年6月以来购买了价值超过48亿美元的芯片。 Nvidia has continued doing business with Ms. Huang’s company, Megaspeed, even after The Times reported last year that the Commerce Department was investigating whether the company was helping China smuggle restricted A.I. chips. (Mr. Huang and Ms. Huang are not related.) 这家公司名为Megaspeed。去年，《纽约时报》曾报道，美国商务部正在调查Megaspeed是否协助中国走私受到出口限制的人工智能芯片，但英伟达此后仍继续与该公司开展业务。 Nvidia and Mr. Huang initially said there was nothing problematic or unusual about his relationship with Ms. Huang. In an interview with Bloomberg News last month, he said that his interactions with Ms. Huang had been “related to Megaspeed, and it was all completely normal and not unusual.” 英伟达和黄仁勋最初坚称，他与黄乐的关系没有任何问题，也没有任何不寻常之处。上个月接受彭博新闻社采访时，黄仁勋表示，他与黄乐的往来“都与Megaspeed有关，完全正常，没有什么特别之处”。 The relationship and affair are a rare misstep for Mr. Huang. 这段关系和婚外情对黄仁勋来说是罕见的一次失误。 Over the past three years, he could do no wrong. His chipmaker, which makes the technology to build artificial intelligence, grew into one of the world’s most valuable companies and the engine of the data center boom powering the U.S. economy. Mr. Trump became an ally and invited him on Air Force One. He started being followed by autograph-seeking throngs at events. And his black leather jackets, which he wears daily, became collectors’ items. 过去三年里，黄仁勋可谓顺风顺水。他领导的芯片公司生产用于构建人工智能系统的关键技术，发展为全球市值最高的企业之一，也成为推动美国经济的数据中心建设热潮的核心力量。特朗普与他结为盟友，还邀请他乘坐“空军一号”总统专机。每逢出席活动，会有大批人群追着他索要签名。他每天穿着的黑色皮夹克也成了收藏者追捧的物品。 As his business boomed, Mr. Huang moved his family to the center of it. Spencer, his son, is a director of product management who plays a leading role in the company’s robotics efforts. Madison, his daughter, is a senior director of product marketing, also works in robotics and on the company’s communications and marketing efforts. His son-in-law, Nico Caprez, is on the company’s business development team. 随着业务蓬勃发展，黄仁勋也让家人进入了公司的核心业务领域。他的儿子斯宾塞担任产品管理总监，在公司的机器人业务中发挥主导作用。女儿麦迪逊是产品营销高级总监，同样参与机器人业务，并负责公司的传播和营销工作。他的女婿尼科·卡普雷斯则在公司的业务拓展团队任职。 Mr. Huang has credited his wife, Lori, whom he married in 1985, with making it possible for him to build the company. They met when he was a teenage engineering student at Oregon State University. She was one of three women in a 250-person engineering lab. Mr. Huang, who had skipped two grades of high school, arranged to be in her lab group and tried to impress her with his intellect. 黄仁勋曾表示，自己创业成功离不开妻子洛丽的支持。两人于1985年结婚，最初相识时，黄仁勋还是俄勒冈州立大学一名十几岁的工程系学生。当时，在一个有250人的工程实验室里只有三名女生，洛丽就是其中之一。高中曾跳过两级的黄仁勋设法与她分到同一个实验小组，并试图用自己的聪明才智打动她。 “I know I look like a child and therefore her first impression of me is that I’m pretty smart,” Mr. Huang said during a 2024 discussion about his career at Hong Kong University of Science and Technology. “I walked up to her and said, ‘Do you want to see my homework?’ Then I made her a promise: ‘If you do homework with me every Sunday, I promise you, you’ll get straight A’s.’” “我知道我看起来像个孩子，所以她对我的第一印象是我很聪明，”2024年，黄仁勋在在香港科技大学谈起自己职业生涯时说。“我走到她面前说：‘你想看我的作业吗？’然后我向她承诺：‘如果你每周日都和我一起做作业，我保证，你肯定全拿A。’” Mr. Huang also promised her that by the age of 30 he would be the chief executive of a company. He fulfilled that promise when he co-founded Nvidia in 1993 soon after he turned 30. 黄仁勋还向她承诺，到30岁时他会成为一家公司的首席执行官。1993年，他刚满30岁不久便联合创立了英伟达，兑现了这个承诺。 “Lori took care of everything and I don’t remember her complaining one time,” Mr. Huang said on the podcast “How I Built This.” “That’s the gift that she gave me.” 黄仁勋在播客“我是如何打造这一切的”中说：“洛丽照顾一切事情，我不记得她曾抱怨过一次。这是她送给我的礼物。” The U.S. government, which had been investigating Megaspeed for possibly steering advanced Nvidia A.I. chips to China, began its surveillance of Ms. Huang more than a year ago. In the course of the surveillance, they found that she was in communication with a U.S. citizen who was identified as Mr. Huang. 美国政府一直在调查Megaspeed是否可能将英伟达先进人工智能芯片转运到中国，一年多前开始对黄乐进行监视。在监视过程中，他们发现她与一名被确认为黄仁勋的美国公民有通信。 Officials who had seen that intelligence said they were certain the relationship was romantic. That undercut Nvidia’s original misleading statements to The Times and others over the course of the last year about the nature of Mr. Huang’s relationship with Ms. Huang. 看过该情报的官员说，他们确信两人之间存在恋爱关系。这削弱了英伟达过去一年向《纽约时报》和其他方面就黄仁勋与黄乐关系性质所作的最初误导性声明。 Mr. Trump was briefed roughly a year ago that the U.S. intelligence community had been electronically surveilling Ms. Huang. 大约一年前，特朗普被告知美国情报界一直在对黄乐进行电子监视。 This past spring, Secretary of State Marco Rubio oversaw the drafting of a highly classified memo detailing intelligence showing that Alice Huang was recruited by the Chinese Ministry of State Security to target Mr. Huang. That memo was circulated not long before the president’s trip to China earlier this year. 今年春天，国务卿鲁比奥监督起草了一份高度机密备忘录，详细说明情报显示黄乐被中国国家安全部招募来针对黄仁勋。该备忘录在今年早些时候总统访华前不久被传阅。 As news about the U.S. surveillance of Ms. Huang broke, Mr. Huang’s room to maneuver all but disappeared. Congress wanted him to testify, probably under oath, and reporting on the surveillance raised the possibility that U.S. intelligence knew the nature of his relationship with Ms. Huang. 随着美国监视黄乐的新闻曝光，黄仁勋的回旋余地几乎消失。国会希望他作证——很可能是宣誓作证——而有关监视的报道让人更加相信，美国情报部门可能已经知晓他与黄乐关系的性质。 There was also pressure on Nvidia’s board. In a social media post last month, Senator Elizabeth Warren, the Massachusetts Democrat who is the ranking member on the Senate Banking Committee, which oversees chip sales abroad, said that Mr. Huang and the company’s board “owe Congress answers” about his relationship with the spy. 英伟达董事会也面临压力。上个月，马萨诸塞州民主党参议员、负责监督海外芯片销售的参议院银行委员会资深成员伊丽莎白·沃伦在社交媒体帖子中说，黄仁勋和公司董事会“有义务向国会解释”他与这名间谍之间的关系。 Megaspeed was formed in 2023, when a Chinese online gaming company split off its Singaporean subsidiary. Shortly before, the U.S. government had issued its first broad ban on selling A.I. chips to China. Ms. Huang was listed as Megaspeeed’s managing director when it was created, and later described herself as its chief executive. Megaspeed成立于2023年，当时一家中国网络游戏公司将其新加坡子公司剥离出来。不久之前，美国政府首次发布对华出售人工智能芯片的广泛禁令。公司成立时，黄乐被列为Megaspeed的董事总经理，后来她自称该公司首席执行官。 Information on Ms. Huang’s background is largely absent from the Chinese internet, but according to an online biography, she worked at several major Chinese banks. She then joined a Shanghai-based fund that has ties to wealthy investors and technology companies with data center projects in China, according to a review of corporate and trade records compiled by the platforms WireScreen and Sayari, and an analysis by the Center for Advanced Defense Studies, a Washington nonprofit. 中国互联网上基本没有黄乐的背景信息，但根据一份网上简历，她曾在几家中国大型银行工作。根据WireScreen和Sayari平台汇编的公司和贸易记录，以及华盛顿非营利组织高级国防研究中心的分析，她随后加入了一家总部位于上海的基金，该基金与富有投资者和在中国有数据中心项目的科技公司有联系。 That network of companies has helped to build a massive data center outside Shanghai that caters to the Chinese company Tencent. It also has financial links to the Chinese military establishment, through an investment in a cybersecurity subsidiary of China Electronics Technology Group, one of the country’s largest makers of military technology. 该网络中的公司帮助在上海郊外建设了一个大型数据中心，服务于中国公司腾讯。它还通过对中国电子科技集团一家网络安全子公司的投资，与中国军工体系产生了财务联系；中国电子科技集团是中国最大的军事技术制造商之一。 As Megaspeed’s chip purchases rolled in, Mr. Huang and Ms. Huang began spending time together. In June 2024, he joined her at a bar in Taipei after a local technology trade show. They drank whiskey alongside other A.I. executives. A year later, they dined at a restaurant in Taipei with other executives. Taiwanese media captured her giving him a kiss on the cheek and standing behind him as he spoke to journalists. 随着Megaspeed的芯片采购不断到来，黄仁勋和黄乐开始共处。2024年6月，在台北一场当地科技贸易展结束后，二人在台北一家酒吧见面。他们与其他人工智能高管一起喝威士忌。一年后，他们与其他高管在台北一家餐厅用餐。台湾媒体拍到她亲吻他的脸颊，以及他接受记者采访时她站在他身后的画面。 Their relationship became a preoccupation in Washington, where officials were already alarmed by the large volume of Megaspeed’s purchases. 他们的关系成为华盛顿的关注焦点，此前官员们已经对Megaspeed的大量采购感到警觉。 “This is a classic move from the CCP’s playbook — and another example of why it can never be trusted,” Representative Michael McCaul, a Republican of Texas who is the vice chair of the House Committee on Homeland Security, wrote on social media, referring to the Chinese Communist Party. “The U.S. should immediately pause the shipment of advanced AI chips to China until we can get to the bottom of this incident and ensure our national security is not being undermined.” “这是CCP惯用伎俩的典型手段——也是它为何永远不可信任的又一例证，” 得克萨斯州共和党众议员、众议院国土安全委员会副主席迈克尔·麦考尔在社交媒体上写道，他指的是中国共产党。“美国应立即暂停向中国出口先进的人工智能芯片，直到我们查明此事的真相，并确保我们的国家安全不受损害。” 孟建国(Paul Mozur)对本文有报道贡献。 Tripp Mickle报道英伟达、谷歌和苹果等全球最大的科技公司。他也报道整个科技行业的趋势，包括裁员、生成式AI和机器人出租车等。 Maggie Haberman是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。 Jonathan Swan是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。 Julian E. Barnes为《纽约时报》报道美国情报机构和国际安全事务。他撰写安全相关议题已有20余年。 Ana Swanson报道贸易和国际经济新闻，常驻华盛顿。她从事新闻工作已超过十年。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

BARNES, ANA SWANSON 2026年11月9日 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋是人工智能革命中最有影响力的人物之一，也是特朗普总统颇具影响力的盟友。 Demetrius Freeman for The New York Times Nvidia said on Sunday that it was opening an investigation into Jensen Huang, its chief executive and co-founder, after he acknowledged to the company’s board that he had been intimate with a business executive who U.S. intelligence determined was a Chinese spy . 英伟达周日表示，已对公司首席执行官兼联合创始人黄仁勋展开调查。此前，黄仁勋向公司董事会承认，他曾与一名企业高管发生亲密关系，而美国情报部门认定，该女子是 中国间谍 。 Mr. Huang’s relationship with the woman, who goes by Alice Huang, became a U.S. government concern after surveillance revealed that she was feeding information directly to Beijing. The revelation raised troubling possibilities because Mr. Huang is one of the most powerful figures in the A.I. revolution as well as an influential ally of President Trump. 这名女子名叫黄乐(音，其英文名为Alice Huang)。美国政府的监控发现，她一直直接向北京提供情报，此后，黄仁勋与她的关系引起了美国政府的关注。这一发现引发了令人不安的种种可能性，因为黄仁勋不仅是人工智能革命中最有影响力的人物之一，也是特朗普总统的 重要盟友 。 In a message to the company, Mr. Huang apologized. “I was unfaithful to my wife,” he said. “My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.” 黄仁勋在给公司的情况说明中道歉说：“我对妻子不忠。我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。” Nvidia’s board said that it had “no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised,” but that “the board’s inquiry will examine all available information.” It said Mr. Huang “fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it.” The board did not provide more details about the investigation or how long it would take. 英伟达 董事会表示 ，“没有理由认为国家安全或英伟达的商业机密受到了损害”，但“董事会的调查将审查所有可获得的信息”。董事会表示，黄仁勋“完全支持此次审查，并承诺予以配合”。董事会没有透露调查的更多细节，也没有说明调查将持续多长时间。 Mr. Huang, 63, will continue to lead the company during the investigation, the board said. As a co-founder, he has set up a unique structure at Nvidia where he dictates all aspects of its business while overseeing some 60 people who directly report to him. 董事会表示，63岁的黄仁勋将在调查期间继续领导公司。作为联合创始人，他在英伟达建立了一套独特的管理架构，掌控公司业务的方方面面，并直接管理约60名向他汇报的员工。 “Today’s news will not slow Nvidia,” said John Rizzo, a company spokesman. “Jensen is committed to continuing to lead Nvidia as C.E.O. without interruption.” “今天的新闻不会拖慢英伟达的步伐，”公司发言人约翰·里佐说。“黄仁勋将继续不受干扰地履行首席执行官职责，领导英伟达。” The New York Times reported last month that American intelligence agencies had discovered that Mr. Huang had developed a close relationship with a Chinese citizen and chip buyer, who U.S. officials concluded was gathering intelligence for Beijing. 《纽约时报》上个月 报道 ，美国情报机构发现，黄仁勋与一名中国公民建立了密切关系。此人从事芯片采购业务，美国官员认定她正在为北京搜集情报。 The chip buyer was Ms. Huang or Huang Le, whose biography said she worked in China as a TV reporter before becoming a top executive at a Singapore-based data center company that had become one of Nvidia’s biggest customers in Southeast Asia. It bought more than $4.8 billion in chips since June 2024. 这名芯片采购商就是黄乐。据她的个人履历介绍，她曾在中国担任电视记者，之后成为一家总部位于新加坡的数据中心公司的高管。这家公司后来成为英伟达在东南亚最大的客户之一，自2024年6月以来购买了价值超过48亿美元的芯片。 Nvidia has continued doing business with Ms. Huang’s company, Megaspeed, even after The Times reported last year that the Commerce Department was investigating whether the company was helping China smuggle restricted A.I. chips. She then joined a Shanghai-based fund that has ties to wealthy investors and technology companies with data center projects in China, according to a review of corporate and trade records compiled by the platforms WireScreen and Sayari, and an analysis by the Center for Advanced Defense Studies, a Washington nonprofit. 中国互联网上基本没有黄乐的背景信息，但根据一份网上简历，她曾在几家中国大型银行工作。根据WireScreen和Sayari平台汇编的公司和贸易记录，以及华盛顿非营利组织高级国防研究中心的分析，她随后加入了一家总部位于上海的基金，该基金与富有投资者和在中国有数据中心项目的科技公司有联系。 That network of companies has helped to build a massive data center outside Shanghai that caters to the Chinese company Tencent. It also has financial links to the Chinese military establishment, through an investment in a cybersecurity subsidiary of China Electronics Technology Group, one of the country’s largest makers of military technology. 该网络中的公司帮助在上海郊外建设了一个大型数据中心，服务于中国公司腾讯。它还通过对中国电子科技集团一家网络安全子公司的投资，与中国军工体系产生了财务联系；中国电子科技集团是中国最大的军事技术制造商之一。 As Megaspeed’s chip purchases rolled in, Mr. Huang and Ms. Huang began spending time together. In June 2024, he joined her at a bar in Taipei after a local technology trade show. They drank whiskey alongside other A.I. executives. A year later, they dined at a restaurant in Taipei with other executives. Taiwanese media captured her giving him a kiss on the cheek and standing behind him as he spoke to journalists. 随着Megaspeed的芯片采购不断到来，黄仁勋和黄乐开始共处。2024年6月，在台北一场当地科技贸易展结束后，二人在台北一家酒吧见面。他们与其他人工智能高管一起喝威士忌。一年后，他们与其他高管 在台北一家餐厅用餐 。台湾媒体拍到她亲吻他的脸颊，以及他接受记者采访时她站在他身后的画面。 Their relationship became a preoccupation in Washington, where officials were already alarmed by the large volume of Megaspeed’s purchases. 他们的关系成为华盛顿的关注焦点，此前官员们已经对Megaspeed的大量采购感到警觉。 “This is a classic move from the CCP’s playbook — and another example of why it can never be trusted,” Representative Michael McCaul, a Republican of Texas who is the vice chair of the House Committee on Homeland Security, wrote on social media , referring to the Chinese Communist Party. “The U.S. should immediately pause the shipment of advanced AI chips to China until we can get to the bottom of this incident and ensure our national security is not being undermined.” “这是CCP惯用伎俩的典型手段——也是它为何永远不可信任的又一例证，” 得克萨斯州共和党众议员、众议院国土安全委员会副主席迈克尔·麦考尔 在社交媒体上写道 ，他指的是中国共产党。“美国应立即暂停向中国出口先进的人工智能芯片，直到我们查明此事的真相，并确保我们的国家安全不受损害。” 孟建国(Paul Mozur)对本文有报道贡献。 Tripp Mickle 报道英伟达、谷歌和苹果等全球最大的科技公司。他也报道整个科技行业的趋势，包括裁员、生成式AI和机器人出租车等。 Maggie Haberman 是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。 Jonathan Swan 是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统。 Julian E. Barnes 为《纽约时报》报道美国情报机构和国际安全事务。他撰写安全相关议题已有20余年。 Ana Swanson 报道贸易和国际经济新闻，常驻华盛顿。她从事新闻工作已超过十年。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 美、中、俄三国首脑在深圳会晤？习近平的雄心与顾虑
description: DAVID PIERSON, BERRY WANG2026年11月9日今年9月，中国领导人习近平与美国总统特朗普在华盛顿的美国国家档案馆。 Haiyun Jiang/The New York Times In early 1945, the leaders of the United States, the Soviet Union and Britain met in the Crimean city of Yalta and struck a secret deal promising Moscow special rights in China in return for joining the war against Japan. 1945年初，美国、苏联和英国领导人在克里米亚城市雅尔塔举行会晤，达成了一项秘密协议：作为苏联加入对日作战的交换条件，美英同意给予莫斯科在中国的特殊权益。 But China was not at the table. 但中国没有参与谈判。 “It is a historical lesson of great-power politics that China will never forget,” said Xin Qiang, a U.S.-China expert at Fudan University in Shanghai. “It was all done behind China’s back and at the expense of Chinese interests.” “这是中国永远不会忘记的大国政治历史教训，”上海复旦大学研究中美关系的专家信强说。“这一切都是背着中国进行的，牺牲的是中国的利益。” More than eight decades later, Beijing is weighing whether to host a three-way meeting of President Trump, President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia and Xi Jinping, China’s leader. 八十多年后的今天，北京正在考虑是否主办一场由美国总统特朗普、俄罗斯总统普京和中国领导人习近平参加的三方会晤。 The meeting could affirm China’s ambition to be an indispensable global power on an equal footing with the United States, but it risks echoing the kind of great-power bargaining Beijing has claimed to resent. The prospect of such a gathering, floated by the Kremlin, has raised fears in Ukraine that Mr. Putin might push for a deal with Mr. Trump to end his war and decide the fate of Ukraine — without Kyiv’s involvement. 这样的会晤可以彰显中国想成为与美国平起平坐、不可或缺的全球大国的雄心，但也可能重演北京声称反感的那种大国交易。克里姆林宫放风提出举行这样的会晤，在乌克兰引发了担忧：普京可能推动与特朗普达成结束战争的协议，在基辅缺席的情况下决定乌克兰的命运。 1945年2月，英国首相丘吉尔、美国总统罗斯福和苏联领导人斯大林出席在克里米亚雅尔塔举行的盟国领导人会议。 China confirmed on Wednesday that it is in talks with Russia and the United States about a meeting between the countries’ leaders, presumably on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen, later this month. But it remained unclear if such a gathering would take place. 中国周三证实，正在与俄罗斯和美国就三国领导人会晤进行磋商，据推测会晤将在本月晚些时候于中国南方城市深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会期间举行。但这样的会晤是否会举行，目前仍不清楚。 How Ukraine Complicates China’s Decision 乌克兰问题如何让中国的决定变得复杂 China is wary of providing a platform for Mr. Putin to cut a deal with Washington over Ukraine. 中国对为普京提供与华盛顿就乌克兰问题达成交易的平台持谨慎态度。 Doing so would contradict Beijing’s position that peace talks require participation from Ukraine and Europe. Mr. Xi appeared to make that point as recently as last week. 这样做将与北京的立场相矛盾：北京认为，和平谈判需要乌克兰和欧洲参与。习近平上周似乎还强调了这一点。 President Frank-Walter Steinmeier of Germany, who visited Beijing, told a German broadcaster that when he met with Mr. Xi, the Chinese leader made it clear that he did not think the United States, Russia and China would be discussing the fate of Ukraine in Shenzhen. 访问北京的德国总统施泰因迈尔对一家德国广播公司说，他在与习近平会晤时，后者明确表示，他认为美国、俄罗斯和中国不会在深圳讨论乌克兰的命运。 “You could see the irritation on his face. He even asked where such rumors were coming from,” Mr. Steinmeier said. “你可以看出他脸上的不悦。他甚至问，这些传言是从哪里来的，”施泰因迈尔说。 “He explicitly stated that this is a European conflict and that the Europeans must be at the table,” he added. “他明确表示，这是欧洲的冲突，欧洲人必须参与谈判，”他补充说。 德国总统施泰因迈尔在北京。谈及习近平对商讨乌克兰问题的反应时，施泰因迈尔说：“你可以看出他脸上的不悦。” President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine has also expressed reservations about the possible talks, saying last week, “I really don’t want this to be ‘Yalta 2, 3, 4’ when there is a redistribution of influence,” according to Ukraine’s state news agency, Ukrinform. 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基也对可能举行的会谈表示保留。据乌克兰国家通讯社报道，他上周说：“我真的希望这不会演变成某种‘雅尔塔2.0、3.0或4.0’式的局面，让各方重新划分势力范围。” Some in China view the secret bargain agreed on at the Yalta conference near the end of World War II as a betrayal. China’s then Nationalist government was pressed to relinquish its claim to what is now Mongolia and grant the Soviets special naval, transportation and commercial rights in Manchuria, in northeastern China. 一些中国人认为，第二次世界大战接近尾声时雅尔塔会议达成的秘密交易是一种背叛。当时的中国国民政府受到压力，被迫放弃对今蒙古国领土的主权主张，并给予苏联在中国东北满洲地区的特殊海军、交通运输和商业权益。 A modern-day huddle involving the world’s three biggest nuclear-armed states would sit awkwardly with the image that Beijing has sought to project of itself as a champion for the interests of weaker nations. (In reality, China is not shy about flexing its muscle against smaller countries like the Philippines.) 如今，如果全球三大核武国家的领导人聚首，将与北京一直试图塑造的形象格格不入：中国一直将自己描绘为弱小国家利益的捍卫者。（事实上，中国在面对菲律宾等较小国家时，并不吝于展示自己的实力。） “No matter what Putin, Xi, and Trump might discuss, the imagery of them meeting would raise questions about whether it implied some kind of condominium of great powers that would disregard the interests of smaller nations,” said Joseph Torigian, a historian of the Chinese Communist Party at American University in Washington. “无论普京、习近平和特朗普可能讨论什么，他们会面的画面本身就会引发疑问：这是否意味着某种无视小国利益的大国共治，”华盛顿美利坚大学研究中国共产党历史的学者唐志学(Joseph Torigian)说。 “It would indeed be ironic for the Chinese if they decide that a trilateral meeting is nonetheless worth it for some reason,” he added. “如果中国人出于某种原因，仍然认为三方会晤值得举行，那确实会很具讽刺意味，”他补充说。 Beijing Does Not Want to Discuss Nukes 北京不想讨论核问题 Mr. Trump has said he would like to use a three-way meeting with Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin in Shenzhen to discuss denuclearization. The last nuclear arms control treaty between the United States and Russia expired in February, and China is rapidly building its nuclear arsenal. 特朗普表示，他希望利用在深圳与习近平和普京举行三方会晤的机会讨论无核化问题。美俄之间最后一项核军控条约已于今年2月到期，而中国正在迅速扩充核武库。 For Beijing, however, the topic is a nonstarter. Under Mr. Xi, China has shifted away from its decades-old strategy of maintaining an arsenal that would provide only a “minimum deterrent.” Instead, it is amassing a stockpile that could one day rival those of Washington and Moscow and has resisted placing limits on its development of nuclear weapons. It also has far fewer warheads — an estimated 620 — compared with more than 5,000 each for Russia and the United States, according to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute. 然而，对北京来说，这个话题没有商量余地。在习近平领导下，中国已经放弃奉行数十年的仅维持“最低限度威慑”的核武库战略，转而大力扩充一个有朝一日可能与华盛顿和莫斯科比肩的核武库，并一直抵制对其核武器发展设定限制。据斯德哥尔摩国际和平研究所估计，中国的核弹头数量要少得多，约为620枚，而俄罗斯和美国各自都超过5000枚。 中国去年在北京的阅兵式上展示了战略核导弹。中国一直拒绝对其核武器发展施加限制。 Asked last month if China would agree to discuss denuclearization in Shenzhen with the United States and Russia, a Foreign Ministry spokeswoman, Mao Ning, deflected. She said that it was Washington that had the primary responsibility to disarm, adding that it was “neither fair, reasonable nor realistic” to ask China to engage in nuclear disarmament negotiations. 上个月，当被问及中国是否愿意在深圳与美国和俄罗斯讨论无核化问题时，中国外交部发言人毛宁回避了该问题。她表示，华盛顿对核裁军负有首要责任，并补充说，要求中国参与核裁军谈判“不公平、不合理，也不可行”。 Still, Chinese analysts suggest Beijing could agree to something narrower. 不过，中国分析人士认为，北京可能愿意就范围更有限的议题展开讨论。 Zhao Long, a security expert at the Shanghai Institutes for International Studies, said China might be open to talks on reducing the risks around a nuclear conflict. 上海国际问题研究院安全问题专家赵隆表示，中国可能愿意讨论如何降低核冲突风险。 That could include improving channels for communicating during crises and ensuring that even in the era of artificial intelligence, the countries maintain human control over nuclear decision-making — an issue on which China and the United States agreed in 2024. 这可能包括改善危机期间的沟通渠道，以及确保即使在人工智能时代，各国仍由人类掌控核决策。中美两国已于2024年在后一问题上达成共识。 The Risks of Playing Host 主办会晤的风险 For all its reservations, Beijing is unlikely to turn Mr. Trump and Mr. Putin down, said Ryan Hass, a former career diplomat and White House national security official now at the Brookings Institution. 曾任职业外交官和白宫国家安全官员、现任职于布鲁金斯学会的何瑞恩(Ryan Hass)认为，尽管有诸多保留，北京仍不太可能拒绝特朗普和普京。 Mr. Hass recently made a trip to Beijing and met with Chinese officials and scholars who were interested in discussing what Mr. Trump wanted to get out of a trilateral meeting. 何瑞恩最近访问了北京，会见了一些中国官员和学者，他们有兴趣探讨特朗普希望从三方会晤中得到什么。 Mr. Hass came away with the impression that Beijing wanted to reap the rewards of a historic meeting, but was wary of the burden of making it a success. 这次访问给何瑞恩留下的印象是，北京希望从这场历史性会晤中获得好处，却又担心要承担确保会晤成功的责任。 今年5月，习近平在北京会见俄罗斯总统普京。 “Xi typically avoids owning responsibility for high-profile diplomatic events with uncertain outcomes, so this event will stretch the Chinese side’s comfort zone,” Mr. Hass said. “习近平通常会避免为结果不确定的重大外交活动承担责任，因此，这场会晤会超出中方的舒适区，”哈斯说。 To many officials in the West, China plays a key role in influencing Moscow because Russia has become so diplomatically and economically dependent on Beijing. In 2024, NATO accused China of being a “decisive enabler of Russia’s war against Ukraine,” urging it to halt shipments of “weapons components” and other technology that Russia needs to rebuild its military. 在许多西方官员看来，中国在影响莫斯科方面发挥着关键作用，因为俄罗斯在外交和经济上已如此依赖北京。2024年，北约指责中国是“俄罗斯对乌克兰战争的决定性助推者”，敦促其停止向俄罗斯运送重建军队所需的“武器部件”和其他技术。 But to Beijing, China has little to do with the conflict that it did not help start and has not militarily supported. Some Chinese analysts suggest the most that Beijing could do was accommodate the talks while trying to distance itself from the idea that it can exert pressure on the Kremlin. 但在北京看来，中国与这场冲突没有多大关系：战争不是中国挑起的，中国也没有向俄罗斯提供军事支持。一些中国分析人士认为，北京最多只能为谈判提供便利，同时尽量避免给外界留下中国能够向克里姆林宫施压的印象。 “If the United States and Russia want to talk, then China can’t tell them not to,” said Song Guoyou, an expert on U.S.-China relations at Fudan University in Shanghai. “如果美国和俄罗斯想谈，中国总不能不让他们谈，”上海复旦大学中美关系专家宋国友说。 If the three leaders met and the topic of Ukraine was on the agenda, he said, China would just be “a facilitator of dialogue, a provider of the platform, and a neutral witness.” 他说，如果三国领导人举行会晤，乌克兰问题又被列入议程，那么中国只会是“对话的促进者、平台的提供者和中立的见证者”。 Valerie Hopkins和Jim Tankersley对本文有报道贡献、Pei-Lin Wu对本文有研究贡献。 David Pierson报道中国外交政策和中国与世界的经济与文化交互。他从事新闻工作已超过20年。 Berry Wang是《纽约时报》记者/研究员，常驻香港。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

He even asked where such rumors were coming from,” Mr. Steinmeier said. “你可以看出他脸上的不悦。他甚至问，这些传言是从哪里来的，”施泰因迈尔说。 “He explicitly stated that this is a European conflict and that the Europeans must be at the table,” he added. “他明确表示，这是欧洲的冲突，欧洲人必须参与谈判，”他补充说。 德国总统施泰因迈尔在北京。谈及习近平对商讨乌克兰问题的反应时，施泰因迈尔说：“你可以看出他脸上的不悦。” President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine has also expressed reservations about the possible talks, saying last week, “I really don’t want this to be ‘Yalta 2, 3, 4’ when there is a redistribution of influence,” according to Ukraine’s state news agency, Ukrinform . 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基也对可能举行的会谈表示保留。据乌克兰国家通讯社 报道 ，他上周说：“我真的希望这不会演变成某种‘雅尔塔2.0、3.0或4.0’式的局面，让各方重新划分势力范围。” Some in China view the secret bargain agreed on at the Yalta conference near the end of World War II as a betrayal. China’s then Nationalist government was pressed to relinquish its claim to what is now Mongolia and grant the Soviets special naval, transportation and commercial rights in Manchuria, in northeastern China. 一些中国人认为，第二次世界大战接近尾声时雅尔塔会议达成的秘密交易是一种背叛。当时的中国国民政府受到压力，被迫放弃对今蒙古国领土的主权主张，并给予苏联在中国东北满洲地区的特殊海军、交通运输和商业权益。 A modern-day huddle involving the world’s three biggest nuclear-armed states would sit awkwardly with the image that Beijing has sought to project of itself as a champion for the interests of weaker nations. (In reality, China is not shy about flexing its muscle against smaller countries like the Philippines.) 如今，如果全球三大核武国家的领导人聚首，将与北京一直试图塑造的形象格格不入：中国一直将自己描绘为弱小国家利益的捍卫者。（事实上，中国在面对菲律宾等较小国家时，并不吝于展示自己的实力。） “No matter what Putin, Xi, and Trump might discuss, the imagery of them meeting would raise questions about whether it implied some kind of condominium of great powers that would disregard the interests of smaller nations,” said Joseph Torigian, a historian of the Chinese Communist Party at American University in Washington. “无论普京、习近平和特朗普可能讨论什么，他们会面的画面本身就会引发疑问：这是否意味着某种无视小国利益的大国共治，”华盛顿美利坚大学研究中国共产党历史的学者唐志学(Joseph Torigian)说。 “It would indeed be ironic for the Chinese if they decide that a trilateral meeting is nonetheless worth it for some reason,” he added. “如果中国人出于某种原因，仍然认为三方会晤值得举行，那确实会很具讽刺意味，”他补充说。 Beijing Does Not Want to Discuss Nukes 北京不想讨论核问题 Mr. Trump has said he would like to use a three-way meeting with Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin in Shenzhen to discuss denuclearization. The last nuclear arms control treaty between the United States and Russia expired in February , and China is rapidly building its nuclear arsenal. 特朗普表示，他希望利用在深圳与习近平和普京举行三方会晤的机会讨论无核化问题。美俄之间最后一项核军控条约已 于今年2月到期 ，而中国正在迅速扩充核武库。 For Beijing, however, the topic is a nonstarter. Under Mr. Xi , China has shifted away from its decades-old strategy of maintaining an arsenal that would provide only a “ minimum deterrent .” Instead, it is amassing a stockpile that could one day rival those of Washington and Moscow and has resisted placing limits on its development of nuclear weapons. It also has far fewer warheads — an estimated 620 — compared with more than 5,000 each for Russia and the United States, according to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute . 然而，对北京来说，这个话题没有商量余地。 在习近平领导下 ，中国已经放弃奉行数十年的仅维持“ 最低限度威慑 ”的核武库战略，转而大力扩充一个有朝一日可能与华盛顿和莫斯科比肩的核武库，并一直抵制对其核武器发展设定限制。据 斯德哥尔摩国际和平研究所 估计，中国的核弹头数量要少得多，约为620枚，而俄罗斯和美国各自都超过5000枚。 中国去年在北京的阅兵式上展示了战略核导弹。中国一直拒绝对其核武器发展施加限制。 Asked last month if China would agree to discuss denuclearization in Shenzhen with the United States and Russia, a Foreign Ministry spokeswoman, Mao Ning, deflected. She said that it was Washington that had the primary responsibility to disarm, adding that it was “neither fair, reasonable nor realistic” to ask China to engage in nuclear disarmament negotiations. 上个月，当被问及中国是否愿意在深圳与美国和俄罗斯讨论无核化问题时，中国外交部发言人毛宁回避了该问题。她表示，华盛顿对核裁军负有首要责任，并补充说，要求中国参与核裁军谈判“不公平、不合理，也不可行”。 Still, Chinese analysts suggest Beijing could agree to something narrower. 不过，中国分析人士认为，北京可能愿意就范围更有限的议题展开讨论。 Zhao Long, a security expert at the Shanghai Institutes for International Studies, said China might be open to talks on reducing the risks around a nuclear conflict. 上海国际问题研究院安全问题专家赵隆表示，中国可能愿意讨论如何降低核冲突风险。 That could include improving channels for communicating during crises and ensuring that even in the era of artificial intelligence, the countries maintain human control over nuclear decision-making — an issue on which China and the United States agreed in 2024. 这可能包括改善危机期间的沟通渠道，以及确保即使在人工智能时代，各国仍由人类掌控核决策。中美两国已于2024年在后一问题上达成共识。 The Risks of Playing Host 主办会晤的风险 For all its reservations, Beijing is unlikely to turn Mr. Trump and Mr. Putin down, said Ryan Hass, a former career diplomat and White House national security official now at the Brookings Institution. 曾任职业外交官和白宫国家安全官员、现任职于布鲁金斯学会的何瑞恩(Ryan Hass)认为，尽管有诸多保留，北京仍不太可能拒绝特朗普和普京。 Mr. Hass recently made a trip to Beijing and met with Chinese officials and scholars who were interested in discussing what Mr. Trump wanted to get out of a trilateral meeting. 何瑞恩最近访问了北京，会见了一些中国官员和学者，他们有兴趣探讨特朗普希望从三方会晤中得到什么。 Mr. Hass came away with the impression that Beijing wanted to reap the rewards of a historic meeting, but was wary of the burden of making it a success. 这次访问给何瑞恩留下的印象是，北京希望从这场历史性会晤中获得好处，却又担心要承担确保会晤成功的责任。 今年5月，习近平在北京会见俄罗斯总统普京。 “Xi typically avoids owning responsibility for high-profile diplomatic events with uncertain outcomes, so this event will stretch the Chinese side’s comfort zone,” Mr. Hass said. “习近平通常会避免为结果不确定的重大外交活动承担责任，因此，这场会晤会超出中方的舒适区，”哈斯说。 To many officials in the West, China plays a key role in influencing Moscow because Russia has become so diplomatically and economically dependent on Beijing. In 2024, NATO accused China of being a “ decisive enabler of Russia’s war against Ukraine,” urging it to halt shipments of “weapons components” and other technology that Russia needs to rebuild its military. 在许多西方官员看来，中国在影响莫斯科方面发挥着关键作用，因为俄罗斯在外交和经济上已如此依赖北京。2024年，北约指责中国是“俄罗斯对乌克兰战争的 决定性助推者 ”，敦促其停止向俄罗斯运送重建军队所需的“武器部件”和其他技术。 But to Beijing, China has little to do with the conflict that it did not help start and has not militarily supported. Some Chinese analysts suggest the most that Beijing could do was accommodate the talks while trying to distance itself from the idea that it can exert pressure on the Kremlin. 但在北京看来，中国与这场冲突没有多大关系：战争不是中国挑起的，中国也没有向俄罗斯提供军事支持。一些中国分析人士认为，北京最多只能为谈判提供便利，同时尽量避免给外界留下中国能够向克里姆林宫施压的印象。 “If the United States and Russia want to talk, then China can’t tell them not to,” said Song Guoyou, an expert on U.S.-China relations at Fudan University in Shanghai. “如果美国和俄罗斯想谈，中国总不能不让他们谈，”上海复旦大学中美关系专家宋国友说。 If the three leaders met and the topic of Ukraine was on the agenda, he said, China would just be “a facilitator of dialogue, a provider of the platform, and a neutral witness.” 他说，如果三国领导人举行会晤，乌克兰问题又被列入议程，那么中国只会是“对话的促进者、平台的提供者和中立的见证者”。 Valerie Hopkins和Jim Tankersley对本文有报道贡献、Pei-Lin Wu对本文有研究贡献。 David Pierson 报道中国外交政策和中国与世界的经济与文化交互。他从事新闻工作已超过20年。 Berry Wang 是《纽约时报》记者/研究员，常驻香港。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: anthropics/skills
description: Public repository for Agent Skills Note: This repository contains Anthropic's implementation of skills for Claude. For information about the Agent Skills standard, see agentskills.io. Skills Skills are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads dynamically to improve performance on specialized tasks. Skills teach Claude how to complete specific tasks in a repeatable way, whether that's creating documents with your company's brand guidelines, analyzing data using your organization's specific workflows, or automating personal tasks. For more information, check out: What are skills? Using skills in Claude How to create custom skills Equipping agents for the real world with Agent Skills About This Repository This repository contains skills that demonstrate what's possible with Claude's skills system. These skills range from creative applications (art, music, design) to technical tasks (testing web apps, MCP server generation) to enterprise workflows (communications, branding, etc.). Each skill is self-contained in its own folder with a SKILL.md file containing the instructions and metadata that Claude uses. Browse through these skills to get inspiration for your own skills or to understand different patterns and approaches. Many skills in this repo are open source (Apache 2.0). We've also included the document creation & editing skills that power Claude's document capabilities under the hood in the skills/docx, skills/pdf, skills/pptx, and skills/xlsx subfolders. These are also open source (Apache 2.0), and we wanted to share them with developers as a reference for more complex skills that are actively used in a production AI application. Disclaimer These skills are provided for demonstration and educational purposes only. While some of these capabilities may be available in Claude, the implementations and behaviors you receive from Claude may differ from what is shown in these skills. These skills are meant to illustrate patterns and possibilities. Always test skills thoroughly in your own environment before relying on them for critical tasks. Skill Sets ./skills: Skill examples for Creative & Design, Development & Technical, Enterprise & Communication, and Document Skills ./spec: The Agent Skills specification ./template: Skill template Try in Claude Code, Claude.ai, and the API Claude Code You can register this repository as a Claude Code Plugin marketplace by running the following command in Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills Then, to install a specific set of skills: Select Browse and install plugins Select anthropic-agent-skills Select document-skills or example-skills Select Install now Alternatively, directly install either Plugin via: /plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills /plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills After installing the plugin, you can use the skill by just mentioning it. For instance, if you install the document-skills plugin from the marketplace, you can ask Claude Code to do something like: "Use the PDF skill to extract the form fields from path/to/some-file.pdf" Claude.ai These example skills are all already available to paid plans in Claude.ai. To use any skill from this repository or upload custom skills, follow the instructions in Using skills in Claude. Claude API You can use Anthropic's pre-built skills, and upload custom skills, via the Claude API. See the Skills API Quickstart for more. Creating a Basic Skill Skills are simple to create - just a folder with a SKILL.md file containing YAML frontmatter and instructions. You can use the template-skill in this repository as a starting point: --- name: my-skill-name description: A clear description of what this skill does and when to use it --- # My Skill Name [Add your instructions here that Claude will follow when this skill is active] ## Examples - Example usage 1 - Example usage 2 ## Guidelines - Guideline 1 - Guideline 2 The frontmatter requires only two fields: name - A unique identifier for your skill (lowercase, hyphens for spaces) description - A complete description of what the skill does and when to use it The markdown content below contains the instructions, examples, and guidelines that Claude will follow. For more details, see How to create custom skills. Partner Skills Skills are a great way to teach Claude how to get better at using specific pieces of software. As we see awesome example skills from partners, we may highlight some of them here: Notion - Notion Skills for Claude

title: meta/astryx
description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready http://astryx.atmeta.com Astryx An open source design system that's fully customizable and built for how we build now: by people and the agents working alongside them. Currently in Beta · Built on React 19+ and StyleX Docs · Storybook · Sandbox · Contributing · Discord Overview Astryx is an open source design system that grew inside Meta over the last eight years, where it became the most-used and largest design system in the company — powering 13,000+ apps and shaped by the engineers, designers, and product teams who depend on it every day. It ships 150+ accessible components, brand-level theming, dark mode, ready-to-ship templates, and a CLI as one cohesive system. You import pre-built CSS and use typed React components — no build plugin, no styling library to adopt — and both people and AI assistants build with the same tooling. What makes Astryx different: Open internals. Components are built to be composed at any level, not locked behind a closed top-level API. The building blocks you'd reach for are exported directly, and when you need to go deeper, swizzle ejects a component's full source into your project to own. No styling lock-in. Astryx authors its styles with StyleX, but that's invisible to consumers. Override with className using Tailwind, CSS modules, or plain CSS — whatever your project already uses. Customize without wrapping. A theme is a set of CSS custom property overrides, so a designer can make Astryx unmistakably theirs without forking or wrapping component source. Built for people and agents. The API, docs, and CLI are designed together so a person and an AI assistant build the same way, from the same reference. Getting Started Astryx requires React 19 or later (react and react-dom are peer dependencies of @astryxdesign/core). Install Astryx, a theme, and its peer dependencies: # npm npm install @astryxdesign/core @astryxdesign/theme-neutral @stylexjs/stylex npm install -D @astryxdesign/cli # pnpm pnpm add @astryxdesign/core @astryxdesign/theme-neutral @stylexjs/stylex pnpm add -D @astryxdesign/cli # yarn yarn add @astryxdesign/core @astryxdesign/theme-neutral @stylexjs/stylex yarn add -D @astryxdesign/cli You can also install the CLI once for your computer, so astryx works in any folder and every coding agent knows Astryx; in a project, it still runs that project's own version: npm i -g @astryxdesign/cli Project install, global install, or both? astryx docs global/project-global-or-both compares them (both is recommended), and astryx docs global explains how global mode works. The simplest setup is a few CSS imports plus a theme provider — no build plugin, no PostCSS or Babel config. See the @astryxdesign/core README for the full guide (Next.js, Tailwind, Vite, and CDN). For reliable CLI access, add a script to your package.json: "scripts": { "astryx": "node node_modules/@astryxdesign/cli/clients/cli/bin/astryx.mjs" } Then use it as npm run astryx -- component --list. This avoids path errors when AI assistants or new developers invoke the CLI directly. Packages Package Description README @astryxdesign/core Components, theme system, and utilities README @astryxdesign/cli CLI tooling: component docs, templates, scaffolding, themes, and codemods README @astryxdesign/build Build plugins for StyleX source builds README @astryxdesign/theme-* Seven ready-made, fully customizable themes (neutral, butter, chocolate, matcha, stone, gothic, y2k) README @astryxdesign/lab (experimental components) is used internally for Storybook and the sandbox and is not published to npm. @astryxdesign/vega (Vega/Vega-Lite chart wrapper) and @astryxdesign/charts (chart components) are published to npm only under the @canary dist-tag — there is no stable release yet. Principles These are the promises Astryx makes to the people building on it. Guidance over enforcement. Components give you capability rather than guardrails that fight you. Design opinions live in docs and examples — if you pass a value, the component renders it. Strong, documented conventions. Every component follows the same naming, prop, and composition rules, and every one is thoroughly documented — so once you've learned a few, the rest feel familiar, and both people and AI can predict how an unfamiliar component behaves. One system for humans and AI. The API, conventions, docs, and CLI are designed together so people and AI assistants build the same way. Every change that made Astryx easier for AI made it easier for people too. Earned by measurement. We test conventions rather than assert them, hold the results loosely, and revisit them when a new situation proves them wrong. Architecture Foundations The building blocks for visually cohesive and accessible interfaces: typography, color, layout, and accessibility. Components A library of 150+ reusable UI building blocks with full TypeScript support. Patterns Battle-tested design solutions for common interactions and workflows: table pages, detail page layouts, form wizards, navigation patterns, data entry flows. Project Structure Directory Purpose apps/ Example apps, the docsite, and Storybook packages/ Published packages: core, cli, build, themes internal/ Internal tooling: test utilities, eslint plugin, vibe tests Contributing We welcome contributions! See CONTRIBUTING.md for the full guide. Questions, or want a hand with a PR? Come find us in Discord. Our conventions and review rubrics live in the Contributing wiki — including API Conventions, Design Conventions, the Component Lifecycle, the Contributing Templates, and the Blog Review Rubric. Read the relevant rubric before opening a PR. Quick start for contributors: this repo uses Node 22+ on an active LTS line and pnpm 11. Install pnpm directly, or enable Corepack once so the pinned pnpm version installs automatically: corepack enable pnpm install If corepack is missing, install pnpm directly or install Corepack manually; see the troubleshooting notes in CONTRIBUTING.md. The Theme Showcase DOM tests use the root ui project for shared DOM and StyleX test setup. Run pnpm exec vitest run --project ui apps/docsite/src/__tests__/theme-showcase/ from the repository root. License MIT

For reliable CLI access, add a script to your package.json : "scripts": { "astryx": "node node_modules/@astryxdesign/cli/clients/cli/bin/astryx.mjs" } Then use it as npm run astryx -- component --list . This avoids path errors when AI assistants or new developers invoke the CLI directly. Packages Package Description README @astryxdesign/core Components, theme system, and utilities README @astryxdesign/cli CLI tooling: component docs, templates, scaffolding, themes, and codemods README @astryxdesign/build Build plugins for StyleX source builds README @astryxdesign/theme-* Seven ready-made, fully customizable themes (neutral, butter, chocolate, matcha, stone, gothic, y2k) README @astryxdesign/lab (experimental components) is used internally for Storybook and the sandbox and is not published to npm. @astryxdesign/vega (Vega/Vega-Lite chart wrapper) and @astryxdesign/charts (chart components) are published to npm only under the @canary dist-tag — there is no stable release yet. Principles These are the promises Astryx makes to the people building on it. Guidance over enforcement. Components give you capability rather than guardrails that fight you. Design opinions live in docs and examples — if you pass a value, the component renders it. Strong, documented conventions. Every component follows the same naming, prop, and composition rules, and every one is thoroughly documented — so once you've learned a few, the rest feel familiar, and both people and AI can predict how an unfamiliar component behaves. One system for humans and AI. The API, conventions, docs, and CLI are designed together so people and AI assistants build the same way. Every change that made Astryx easier for AI made it easier for people too. Earned by measurement. We test conventions rather than assert them, hold the results loosely, and revisit them when a new situation proves them wrong. Architecture Foundations The building blocks for visually cohesive and accessible interfaces: typography, color, layout, and accessibility. Components A library of 150+ reusable UI building blocks with full TypeScript support. Patterns Battle-tested design solutions for common interactions and workflows: table pages, detail page layouts, form wizards, navigation patterns, data entry flows. Project Structure Directory Purpose apps/ Example apps, the docsite, and Storybook packages/ Published packages: core, cli, build, themes internal/ Internal tooling: test utilities, eslint plugin, vibe tests Contributing We welcome contributions! See CONTRIBUTING.md for the full guide. Questions, or want a hand with a PR? Come find us in Discord . Our conventions and review rubrics live in the Contributing wiki — including API Conventions , Design Conventions , the Component Lifecycle , the Contributing Templates , and the Blog Review Rubric . Read the relevant rubric before opening a PR. Quick start for contributors: this repo uses Node 22+ on an active LTS line and pnpm 11 . Install pnpm directly, or enable Corepack once so the pinned pnpm version installs automatically: corepack enable pnpm install If corepack is missing, install pnpm directly or install Corepack manually; see the troubleshooting notes in CONTRIBUTING.md . The Theme Showcase DOM tests use the root ui project for shared DOM and StyleX test setup. Run pnpm exec vitest run --project ui apps/docsite/src/__tests__/theme-showcase/ from the repository root. description: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks https://sherlockproject.xyz Hunt down social media accounts by username across 400+ social networks Installation • Usage • Contributing Installation Warning Packages for ParrotOS and Ubuntu 24.04, maintained by a third party, appear to be broken. Users of these systems should defer to uv/pipx/pip or Docker. Method Notes pipx install sherlock-project pip or uv may be used in place of pipx docker run -it --rm sherlock/sherlock dnf install sherlock-project Community-maintained packages are available for Debian (>= 13), Ubuntu (>= 22.10), Homebrew, Kali, and BlackArch. These packages are not directly supported or maintained by the Sherlock Project. See all alternative installation methods here. General usage To search for only one user: sherlock user123 To search for more than one user: sherlock user1 user2 user3 Accounts found will be stored in an individual text file with the corresponding username (e.g user123.txt). $ sherlock --help usage: sherlock [-h] [--version] [--verbose] [--folderoutput FOLDEROUTPUT] [--output OUTPUT] [--csv] [--xlsx] [--site SITE_NAME] [--proxy PROXY_URL] [--dump-response] [--json JSON_FILE] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--print-all] [--print-found] [--no-color] [--browse] [--local] [--nsfw] [--txt] [--ignore-exclusions] USERNAMES [USERNAMES ...] Sherlock: Find Usernames Across Social Networks (Version 0.16.0) positional arguments: USERNAMES One or more usernames to check with social networks. Check similar usernames using {?} (replace to '_', '-', '.'). options: -h, --help show this help message and exit --version Display version information and dependencies. --verbose, -v, -d, --debug Display extra debugging information and metrics. --folderoutput FOLDEROUTPUT, -fo FOLDEROUTPUT If using multiple usernames, the output of the results will be saved to this folder. --output OUTPUT, -o OUTPUT If using single username, the output of the result will be saved to this file. --csv Create Comma-Separated Values (CSV) File. --xlsx Create the standard file for the modern Microsoft Excel spreadsheet (xlsx). --site SITE_NAME Limit analysis to just the listed sites. Add multiple options to specify more than one site. --proxy PROXY_URL, -p PROXY_URL Make requests over a proxy. e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:1080 --dump-response Dump the HTTP response to stdout for targeted debugging. --json JSON_FILE, -j JSON_FILE Load data from a JSON file or an online, valid, JSON file. Upstream PR numbers also accepted. --timeout TIMEOUT Time (in seconds) to wait for response to requests (Default: 60) --print-all Output sites where the username was not found. --print-found Output sites where the username was found (also if exported as file). --no-color Don't color terminal output --browse, -b Browse to all results on default browser. --local, -l Force the use of the local data.json file. --nsfw Include checking of NSFW sites from default list. --txt Enable creation of a txt file --ignore-exclusions Ignore upstream exclusions (may return more false positives) Credits Thank you to everyone who has contributed to Sherlock! ❤️ Star History License MIT © Sherlock Project Creator - Siddharth Dushantha
